themes.name: Infinite library
themes.author: Paolo Nenzi
themes.description: Thirty-two halls of an endless library: knowledge, botany, the bestiary, the stars, alchemy, the sea, time, memory, machines; in sepia and in colour.

themes.name: Ukiyo-e
themes.author: Paolo Nenzi
themes.description: Ten places and ten feasts of the world as Japanese woodblock prints, panoramic. The feasts on fixed days come with their festive days.
